scenario_description: Original real/hybrid 2019 profile; no IT-load modification.
it_load_transformation: No IT-load modification; retains the original real/hybrid IT-load profile.
cooling_model_note: Original modeled cooling ratio retained: P_cooling = P_IT * cooling_ratio_model.

scenario_description: Synthetic sensitivity case with IT load scaled uniformly to 75% of baseline.
it_load_transformation: P_IT,t = 0.75 × baseline P_IT,t at every interval.
cooling_model_note: Cooling recalculated from scaled IT load and the original time-varying cooling ratio.

scenario_description: Synthetic sensitivity case with IT load scaled uniformly to 125% of baseline.
it_load_transformation: P_IT,t = 1.25 × baseline P_IT,t at every interval.
cooling_model_note: Cooling recalculated from scaled IT load and the original time-varying cooling ratio.

scenario_description: Synthetic AI-training blocks on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday from 08:00 to 16:00 UTC.
it_load_transformation: P_IT,t = 1.45 × baseline during Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday 08:00–16:00 UTC; baseline otherwise.
cooling_model_note: Cooling follows the original time-varying ratio after burst-related IT-load modification.

scenario_description: Synthetic stable cloud-service profile formed by a centered four-hour rolling mean with daily energy preservation.
it_load_transformation: Centered four-hour (16 interval) rolling mean, normalized separately each UTC day to preserve baseline daily IT energy.
cooling_model_note: Cooling follows the original time-varying ratio after smoothing and daily energy normalization.

scenario_description: Synthetic flexible-batch case shifting 20% of daily IT energy toward lower-price, lower-carbon, non-DR intervals.
it_load_transformation: 80% inflexible and 20% daily flexible energy redistributed with price, carbon, and DR preference; daily IT energy preserved.
cooling_model_note: Cooling follows the original time-varying ratio; IT energy is preserved separately for every UTC day.

scenario_description: Synthetic thermal-stress case retaining IT load while increasing cooling sensitivity in the hottest ambient-temperature decile.
it_load_transformation: IT load retained unchanged; cooling ratio increases progressively by up to 25% in the hottest ambient-temperature decile.
cooling_model_note: Cooling ratio increases progressively by up to 25% within the hottest ambient-temperature decile.

scenario_description: Synthetic difficult case increasing IT load by 25% during DR events and within one-hour event shoulders.
it_load_transformation: P_IT,t = 1.25 × baseline during DR-active intervals and a centered ±1-hour shoulder; baseline otherwise.
cooling_model_note: Cooling follows the original time-varying ratio after DR-coincident IT-load modification.
